Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production animation sprite sheet for the Kaling Windows pet. Image 1 is the canonical identity/outfit reference. Change only pose/expression as specified.
Exactly FOUR equal columns and 5 equal rows, 20 complete separate character sprites. Canvas 1536 x 1920 pixels; each invisible cell is 384 x 384. Strict regular aligned grid with generous transparent gutters. No visible cell borders or labels.
Preserve the attached reference character and outfit exactly: red hair, face, hair bows, gold eye on viewer-left and cyan eye on viewer-right. Same garments, colors, footwear, head size and body proportions in EVERY frame.
ROW 1, left to right four chronological frames: enjoying head petting, no external hand: eyes gently close and smile, head tilts left happily, shy pink blush and tiny shoulder raise, contented head tilt right. Four visibly different but connected poses.
ROW 2, left to right four chronological frames: eating cookie: both hands hold a round cookie below mouth, raise cookie to mouth, take a small bite, lower partly bitten cookie with happy puffed cheeks. Cookie touches hands, no crumbs.
ROW 3, left to right four chronological frames: eating pudding: one hand holds a small pudding cup and other a spoon, scoop, spoon at mouth, delighted chewing. Cup stays in same hand. No crumbs.
ROW 4, left to right four chronological frames: drinking tea: both hands around a small pale cup, raise it toward lips, sip, lower cup with contented eyes. Cup always attached to hands; no steam.
ROW 5, left to right four chronological frames: sitting and swinging feet: seated upright as if on an invisible ledge, left foot forward, both feet down, right foot forward, feet down again. Keep head and torso same size as standing reference; seated head sits lower. No chair/ledge drawn.
Every sprite must be wholly within its own cell with 20px transparent margins. Keep constant character scale across all cells; a sitting sprite must be shorter rather than scaled larger. Standing feet baseline is y=350 within each cell; only jumping/lifted poses leave it. Transparent background with true alpha. No floor shadows, scenery, text, grid, sparkles, motion trails, detached symbols or extra characters.
